data.segment_description:
(Studio: Tom Brokaw) The threat from Hurricane Ivan to the Caribbean and Florida noted; map shown of Ivan’s projected path. 
 (Kingston, Jamaica: Mark Potter) Preparations for the approaching storm featured; scenes shown of residents in shelters in Jamaica, of destruction from Ivan in Grenada, of damage from Hurricane Charley in Cuba and people evacuating from the Florida Keys; footage shown of damage from 1988’s Hurricane Gilbert in Jamaica. [In Jamaica, evacuee Paula PAISLEY†- comments.] [Jamaican Minister of Land & Environment Dean PEART†- urges people to evacuate.] [In Key West, Florida, WOMAN – says she is evacuating.] [Punta Gorda, Florida, resident Kelly Marie HESLIN†- says this one looks bad.] 
 (Studio: Tom Brokaw) The views of Dr. Marshall Shepard††, a meteorologist at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center, on this year’s hectic hurricane season and what it means presented in his own words. [SHEPARD – cites trends; says this active phase started in 1995; comments on the influence of El Nino patterns and global warming.]

data.segment_title: Decision 2004 / Bush vs. Kerry / Bush’s Service Record / Medicare
data.segment_description:
(Studio: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced. 
 (Chillicothe, Ohio: David Gregory) The political storm over the authenticity of documents provided by CBS News in a report that raised questions about President Bush’s National Guard service examined; details given of typographical anomalies in the documents; scenes shown of Bush campaigning in West Virginia with Senator Zell Miller. [BUSH – criticizes Senator John Kerry’s position on the Iraq war.] [Forensic document specialist William FLYNN†- doubts the documents are genuine.] [Democratic National Committee chairman Terry McAULIFFE†- says Bush has lied to the American public.] 
 (Studio: Tom Brokaw) Kerry’s criticism of Bush’s new Medicare prescription drug plan noted. 
 (Allentown, Pennsylvania: Kelly O’Donnell) The political debate over Medicare examined; campaign ads shown; details given of the confusion over the prescription drug plan and the ban on buying cheaper drugs from Canada. [In Missouri, KERRY; in West Virginia, BUSH – campaign on Medicare.] [SENIOR – comments.]

 (New York: Anne Thompson) The changes in the workplace since 9/11 featured; statistics on security spending cited. [Giordano’s Pizza general manager Amer DIVANOVIC†- talks about dealing with security in office buildings.] [Corporate Express Mark HOFFMAN†- comments on increased efficiency due to video conferencing.] [Kroll, Inc. security specialist Michael CHERKASKY††- talks about corporate spending on security.] 
 (Studio: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced. 
 (Washington: Bob Faw) A look at life before 9/11 and now presented. [Public policy scholar Robert PUTNAM†- notes we have not translated talk about community into an enduring effect.] [9/11 widow Virginia BAUER††- comments on the pain of losing her husband.]

data.segment_title: 12 Ways to Make America Safer (Part V)
data.segment_description:
(Studio: Tom Brokaw) Special series on homeland security continued. 
 (Washington: Andrea Mitchell) The danger of terrorists obtaining nuclear weapons examined; excerpt shown from the film “The Peacemaker”; statistics on nuclear material in Russia cited; statement from Al Qaeda leader Osama bin Laden quoted; details given of plans for securing Russia’s “loose nukes.” [Nuclear Threat Initiative former Senator Sam NUNN – says our leaders have not made this a priority.] [Undersecretary of State John BOLTON†- says the Russians know their vulnerability to terrorist groups.] [Harvard University nuclear expert Professor Graham ALLISON†- says this is a preventable catastrophe.] [Secretary of Energy Spencer ABRAHAM†- expresses concern.]
